description.tr: Arena di Verona, Roma İmparatorluğu'ndan kalma eski bir arenadır ve bugün hala konser ve tiyatro gösterileri düzenlenmektedir.
description.en: The Arena di Verona is an ancient Roman amphitheater that still hosts concerts and theater performances today.
description.de: Die Arena di Verona ist ein antikes römisches Amphitheater, das heute noch Konzerte und Theateraufführungen beherbergt.

en: Watch a concert or theater performance

description.tr: Juliet'in Evi, Shakespeare'in ünlü "Romeo ve Juliet" oyununda geçen Juliet'in evine ilham kaynağı olmuştur. Burada Juliet'in büstü ve balkonunu görebilirsiniz.
description.en: Juliet's House is the inspiration for the house of Juliet in Shakespeare's famous play "Romeo and Juliet". You can see Juliet's statue and the balcony here.
description.de: Juliets Haus ist die Inspiration für das Haus von Julia in Shakespeares berühmtem Stück "Romeo und Julia". Hier kann man Julias Statue und den Balkon sehen.

en: Admire the view from the balcony
Write a wish on Juliet's statue
de: Einen Wunsch auf Julias Statue schreiben
